slots.anchor: Computing has an old image for this.
slots.brief: Margin vignette: a mechanical press printing the blueprints of a slightly better version of itself; the previous three presses stand behind it in a receding line, each a little cruder. 1962 workshop atmosphere, punch cards in a tray.

slots.anchor: The reinforcement learner looks autonomous because the teacher moved into the walls.
slots.brief: Corner scene: a schoolroom where the teacher's silhouette is half-absorbed into the wall machinery — her hand still visible holding the scoreboard, gears where her coat was; at the desk, a small robot solves problems, believing itself alone. Tender, uncanny.

slots.anchor: an uncontrollable noisy television can remain fascinating forever
slots.brief: Small spot: a round robot sitting cross-legged, transfixed by an old television showing pure static; its notebook of discoveries blank. Deadpan.
Margin vignette: two clockwork creatures running hard on a landscape that is itself a rolling conveyor of hills; neither gains. Wind in the grass, watercolor motion.

Corner scene: an empty classroom at dusk; at the teacher's desk a student robot has the gradebook open, pen hovering — its own row of marks already suspiciously perfect. Through the window, the real unfinished homework blows across the yard.

slots.text: Recursive self-improvement does not solve Goodhart. It gives Goodhart compound interest.
We have reinvented constitutional government because the AI wanted a better benchmark score.
